name: agy-bridge
description: Drive Antigravity CLI (agy) on this machine as a sub-agent of Claude Code, with a live output pane.

agy_path.title: agy executable
agy_path.description: Command or full path of the Antigravity CLI, e.g. agy, /opt/homebrew/bin/agy or C:\Users\me\AppData\Local\agy\bin\agy.exe

default_cwd.title: Default working directory
default_cwd.description: Directory agy runs in when a tool call gives none; empty uses the Claude Code session's own directory

model.title: agy model
model.description: agy --model slug; empty uses agy's default
